faq.title: Policies & FAQ
faq.a1: Free cancellation up to 12 hours before departure; 50% refund up to 2 hours before. No refund after departure.
faq.q2: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a2: Two checked bags up to 20kg total plus one cabin bag on VIP and Business; 15kg on Standard.
faq.q3: Do I need an ID to board?
faq.a3: Yes — bring the national ID, passport or student ID that matches the passenger name on the ticket.
faq.q4: Can I change my travel date?
faq.a4: Yes, once per booking and up to 6 hours before departure, from My Trips in your dashboard.

header.title: Coaches maintained like aircraft
header.subtitle: A young fleet, serviced on a fixed cycle, cleaned between every single trip.

amenities.title: Amenities, in detail
amenities.a1d: Up to 140° recline with adjustable headrest and calf support on VIP.
amenities.a2d: Dual-zone air conditioning, filtered and serviced monthly.
amenities.a3d: A dedicated 2.4A USB-C and USB-A port at every single seat.
amenities.a4d: Seat-back screens with Ethiopian film, music and live route map.
amenities.a5d: Generous hold space plus a secured, numbered tag system.
amenities.a6d: Bottled water and a light snack on every departure over 4 hours.

safety.title: Safety & maintenance
safety.subtitle: The unglamorous work that makes a good trip boring.
safety.s1d: Licence verification, 5 years minimum experience and quarterly re-assessment.
safety.s2d: Speed, braking and fatigue monitoring streamed to our Addis control room.
safety.s3d: Full inspection every 10,000km — no coach leaves the yard on an open ticket.

hero.title: Biftu means first light
hero.subtitle: We started with one coach on the Addis–Wolaita Sodo road and a simple promise: leave on time, arrive rested.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Founded in Wolaita Sodo, Biftu Luxury Bus grew out of a frustration shared by every long-distance traveller in Ethiopia — unpredictable departures, cramped seats and no way to know where your bus actually was.
story.p2: Today we operate a modern fleet across ten cities, with a digital booking platform built for the way Ethiopians actually travel: in three languages, on mobile, paid with Telebirr.
story.m1d: First coach on the Addis–Wolaita Sodo corridor.
story.m2d: Fleet reaches 20 coaches, Hawassa and Arba Minch added.
story.m3d: GPS telematics and control room go live.
story.m4d: Trilingual online booking and QR e-tickets launched.
